Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionTake control of Sproutrex, a small nature-powered mechanical sphere equipped with a propeller, and explore a colorful pixel-art world where plants and machines have grown together. Run, jump, glide and fly your way through 28 handcrafted levels filled with hazards, enemies, moving platforms and environmental challenges. Use Sproutrex's unique abilities to reach new areas, overcome dangerous obstacles and discover different ways through each stage. Along the way, collect coins and mechanical seeds hidden throughout the levels. Find every seed in a stage to earn its Perfect Level medal and prove you've mastered the challenge. But Sproutrex is more than just a machine. In this strange world, nature has found a way to thrive among gears, metal and forgotten mechanisms — and this little robot is living proof that the two can grow together.Show morePublished bytrezegamesDeveloped byOtávio FurlanPlay withXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesSingle player60 fps+Xbox achievementsXbox presenceXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionStart your own diecast car store and turn a small shop into the place every collector visits. Buy sealed surprise boxes from eight Supercar series – Basic, Faster, Pro, Elite, Champion, Master, Extra and Ultra – and open them at your unboxing table. Every box hides a random set of cars, from common runs to the rarest Special editions. Keep the ones you love in your personal collection, or put them on the shelves, set a price and sell them to the collectors who walk through your door. Build the store you want. Add shelves, racing platforms, vending machines and bundle tables. Change floors and walls, hang posters, name your shop and grow it from a single room into a full showroom. Hire cashiers, sales clerks and warehouse workers, manage your stock and watch the store statistics and customer reviews to see what sells. Race on the shop floor. Set up racing platforms, let customers challenge you on the track and win prize money, or take the wheel yourself in test drives. Skill cards give you an edge in every race, and you can sell skill card packs to your customers too. Complete the collection. Visit the Hunt House to track down the cars you are missing, trade with the Black Market for rare finds and exclusive deals, and try your luck at the betting tables. Make it yours. Choose a car, paint it, cover it with stickers, design its card, give it a name and put it up for sale. Every car you create is one of a kind. More than 800 cars are waiting to be unboxed. EXPLORE. SURVIVE. Build anything you can imagine, uncover mysteries, and face thrilling foes in an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. There’s no wrong way to play!VIBRANT VISUALS* Vibrant Visuals is Minecraft’s biggest official visual enhancement – delivering a dazzling cosmetic upgrade with a new modern graphics pipeline and an array of visual improvements. Sunrises are more vivid, water reflects, forests become shaded, and more!INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACKExplore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled! The pack also features 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the iconic Super Mario™ series.CreateBuild anything you can imagine in the ultimate sandbox game. Explore Uncover the mysteries of an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough.SurviveTake on challenging foes, thrilling landscapes and perilous dimensions. PLAY TOGETHER** Have a blast with friends, whether you’re sitting on the same couch in split screen or miles apart in cross-platform play. Connect with millions of players on community servers or join your own private server with up to 10 friends with Realms Plus. EXPERIENCE MORECreator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics are available on the Minecraft Marketplace. Marketplace Pass (or Realms Plus) includes 150+ worlds, skin & textures packs, and more – refreshed monthly. Nintendo Switch™ 2 Features:VIBRANT VISUALS* - Dig into your Minecraft adventure on the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system with Vibrant Visuals support and embark on a journey across a world with enhanced lighting and shadow effects. Enjoy Vibrant Visuals enabled content across Minecraft Marketplace.CARRY OVER DATA FROM THE NINTENDO SWITCH™ VERSION - Nintendo Switch™ worlds can be carried over, so you can pick up right where you left off.INCLUDES THE SUPER MARIO™ MASH-UP PACK - Explore a custom Mario-themed world in the Super Mario™ Mash-Up Pack, with Vibrant Visuals enabled!*Vibrant Visuals not available in some gameplay, including split-screen and when using certain Marketplace Worlds and content. **Cross-platform play requires Microsoft Account.
